# Screen

* [Confirm dialogs (delete and clear completed)](confirm-dialogs.md) - Two native modal dialogs ask for confirmation before a to-do is deleted or all Completed to-dos are cleared, with Cancel as the default focus and the clear dialog naming the number of to-dos.
* [Log-in screen](log-in.md) - The /login page takes an identifier and password, shows one generic message for a refused login, returns the user to a safe to-do route, and shows the session-ended message only after a session ends while signed in.
* [Not-found page](not-found.md) - For a signed-in user, an undefined address shows an animated, decorative "not found" page with a link back to home that plays once, stops within 5 seconds, and never flashes.
* [Sign-up screen](sign-up.md) - The /signup page has one identifier field that takes an email address or a username, a password field, and field-level messages; success returns the user to log in with an account-created message.
* [To-do create and edit form (/todos/new, /todos/:id/edit)](todo-form.md) - One form creates or edits a to-do with title, description, due date and a three-option priority, shows field errors beside their fields, and treats an unknown id as not found.
* [To-do detail screen (/todos/:id)](todo-detail.md) - The detail page shows one to-do's title, status, due date, priority, description and created and updated times in the viewer's time zone, with links to edit and delete and a to-do not-found state.
* [To-do list screen (/todos)](todo-list.md) - The /todos page shows the user's to-dos with a filter, a search box, a clear-completed control, row actions and pagination, with separate first-use, no-match and error states.
